hooks.name: Trap catalog refresh
hooks.description: After a trap sample under samples/traps/ is saved (a .cob, .cpy or .java file, or schema.json), asks the agent to run make traps, then read runs/trap_catalog.txt, which the command writes, and report the Detection Matrix figures in it. The command prints only the paths of the two files it writes, so the figures come from that file. The run takes several minutes and rewrites runs/trap_catalog.json and runs/trap_catalog.txt, which is why it is an agent action and not a command. Limit: it runs on every save of such a file, so a long editing session starts many runs; disable the hook while editing. The agent must report only values it read in this session.

action.prompt: A trap sample under samples/traps/ was just saved. Run `make traps` in the repository root. It runs the full trap catalog and takes several minutes; wait for it to finish. The command prints two lines that start with Wrote when it succeeds, and it writes the Detection Matrix to runs/trap_catalog.txt. Only if those two Wrote lines were printed, read runs/trap_catalog.txt and report, for each case, the case number and name, the status, the detected count out of the cases generated, the detection rate and the correct port verdict, copied exactly as written in the file. Report only values read in this session, never values from memory, from README.md or from docs. If the command fails or the Wrote lines are missing, say so, quote the error text and report no figures. Do not edit any file.
